name: sensors
rc_text:
service gb_sensors_wait /system/bin/sh /odm/gb_sensors.sh wait
    user root
    group root
    seclabel u:r:shell:s0
    oneshot
    disabled

service gb_sensors_diag /system/bin/sh /odm/gb_sensors.sh diag
    user root
    group root system shell
    seclabel u:r:shell:s0
    oneshot
    disabled

on early-boot
    exec_start gb_sensors_wait

on property:sys.boot_completed=1
    start gb_sensors_diag
